name: Volkov-Saito Precision VS-10 Match 'Deadlock'
description:
The Volkov-Saito VS-10 Match is a competition-grade semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm Auto, featuring a six-inch bull barrel, adjustable trigger, and a frame weight system that allows the shooter to customize the weapon's balance. It is the largest and heaviest pistol in Volkov-Saito's lineup, designed for shooters who want maximum accuracy from a maximum-power cartridge.

The Deadlock is an oddity in the Volkov-Saito catalog — a weapon that is too large and heavy for practical carry but too accurate and powerful to be dismissed as merely recreational. In competitive shooting, it dominates the open-caliber division. In the field, the rare operators who carry it pair the 10mm's terminal performance with a level of precision that turns every engagement into a surgical exercise.

The weapon's balance system uses tungsten inserts in the grip and dust cover that the shooter can rearrange to shift the center of gravity forward, rearward, or neutral. This customization means no two Deadlocks handle identically — each is tuned to its owner's grip, stance, and recoil management preferences. The result is a deeply personal weapon that rewards long-term familiarity.
specifications:
caliber: 10mm Auto
effective_range: 75 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 14 rounds
weight: 1.22 kg (adjustable)
tactical_use: A precision large-caliber pistol offering exceptional accuracy at extended range. The 10mm Auto round provides superior terminal performance compared to 9mm and .45 ACP alternatives. The adjustable balance system allows the weapon to be optimized for the individual shooter. Too large for concealment — this is an open-carry or holster weapon for deliberate engagements.
cultural_context: The Deadlock is the weapon of people who take shooting seriously as both skill and art. In competitive circles, it represents the pinnacle of pistol precision. Among working professionals, carrying a Deadlock says you are confident enough in your accuracy to carry a weapon that demands it.
story_hooks: A Deadlock is used to make an impossible shot — a target hit at over one hundred meters through a gap in moving machinery. The shooter is either the best marksman in GLMZ or had help no one can identify.
A shipment of custom tungsten weight inserts for Deadlocks is intercepted — analysis reveals the inserts contain embedded tracking devices.

physical_description.visual_profile: A full-sized competition pistol with aggressive, utilitarian geometry. The six-inch bull barrel dominates the profile, creating a front-heavy silhouette that reads as purposeful and uncompromising. Flat-sided frame with sharp angles, minimal ergonomic softness — this is precision engineered for function over comfort. The dust cover extends visibly forward, housing the customizable tungsten weight system.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length: 22.5cm | Barrel length: 15.2cm | Slide height: 13cm | Width at frame: 3.8cm
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial and intentional. At 1.22kg, it's noticeably heavier than service pistols, with a forward bias from the bull barrel and tungsten inserts. Feels planted in the hand — recoil management through mass rather than springs. Adjustable balance means weight distribution shifts subtly depending on owner configuration.
physical_description.primary_material: Stainless steel slide and barrel | Hardened polymer frame (carbon-reinforced) | Tungsten inserts in grip and dust cover | Machined aluminum controls
physical_description.finish: Brushed stainless steel slide with micro-roughened texture to reduce glint. Frame in matte charcoal polymer with subtle grip texture. Barrel shows the characteristic tool marks of precision boring — minor longitudinal striations visible under close inspection. No chrome or glossy surfaces.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: brushed steel-gray with gunmetal undertones | Accents: flat black polymer frame | Trigger and safety lever: polished aluminum silver
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive cross-hatching on polymer grip panels — sharp, almost aggressive texture designed for secure purchase even with wet or gloved hands. Feels deliberately rough, not user-friendly. The tungsten insert access points are knurled aluminum, cold to the touch.
distinctive_features: Six-inch bull barrel with visible precision rifling and slight muzzle crown bevel
Modular tungsten weight inserts visible in dust cover — three distinct ports showing metallic insert edges
Adjustable rear sight with fine-grain elevation and windage turrets (marked in 1/4 MOA increments)
Magazine well slightly beveled for competition speed-loading
Accessory rail under dust cover (Picatinny MIL-STD-1913)
Dual recoil spring guide system visible through disassembly points
Serial number engraved on frame in sans-serif block numerals
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VOLKOV-SAITO PRECISION stamped vertically on left slide in clean sans-serif | VS-10 MATCH engraved below that | Caliber marking: 10MM AUTO on right slide | Small Cyrillic-Latin hybrid logomark (merged V-S) on dust cover in 8mm
physical_description.condition_typical: Competition models arrive pristine with protective cosmoline. Field-used Deadlocks show accelerated wear on grip panels from adjustments and tungsten port edges. Slide scratches from holster friction common. Muzzle crown typically unmarred (protected by owner pride). Dust cover inserts may show oxidation if not properly maintained.
